name: socketrpc-gen
description: Code generator for Socket.IO RPC packages using ts-morph.

scripts.generate:examples: bun run index.ts ./examples/01-basic/define.ts && bun run index.ts ./examples/02-single-extension/define.ts && bun run index.ts ./examples/03-multi-level-extension/define.ts && bun run index.ts ./examples/04-zod-integration/define.ts && bun run index.ts ./examples/00-full-app/pkg/rpc/define.ts && bun run generate:go-example && bun run generate:go-client-example
scripts.generate:go-client-example: bun run index.ts ./examples/06-go-client/define.ts --client go --server go --go-out ./examples/06-go-client/wire --go-package wire --go-client-out ./examples/06-go-client/wireclient --go-client-package wireclient
